h5: Order cancellation in case of unconventional pricing
p5: Low market depth in local markets may sometimes cause the price of transactions to appear higher or lower than the actual price of cryptocurrencies. This happens because some users, unfamiliar with the market, place orders with incorrect prices. Furthermore, in many cases, users' failure to distinguish between a limit order and a stop-limit order, or the entry of incorrect prices, causes irrational price fluctuations, commonly known as 'extreme price ranges,' which ultimately harm them. Despite Artina's warnings when determining unconventional prices, users repeatedly place incorrect orders. Therefore, Artina has an order cancellation option. Based on the number of trades made within the price range, the volume of trades, and the price difference from the market's current price, all or part of the trades may be canceled. However, it is possible that none of these trades will be canceled. This feature provides the possibility for the partial return of losses caused by unconventional order placement. Since the price changes were not real and the transaction occurred due to a pricing error, users who have traded at unrealistic prices are not justified in claiming compensation. The user accepts that Artina will be the authority for considering and deciding on matters related to fairness in transactions. Since canceled trades affect the chart and canceling trades does not correct the chart, candlestick charts will display long wicks for the reasons explained. Therefore, Artina's chart is not a reference for the actual price of transactions. The rule for canceling orders at unconventional prices will be abolished as market depth increases and user knowledge improves.

p8: In order to comply with anti-money laundering laws, all users need to confirm their identity. Identity verification occurs in five steps by providing relevant documents. Email verification: After registering with Artina, a confirmation link will be sent to the registered email address. By confirming this link, the first step of identity verification will be completed. Mobile phone number verification: By entering the mobile number, a confirmation code will be sent to it, and it will be confirmed by entering the code in Artina. Pay close attention when entering your mobile number, as this will be one of the ways we will communicate with you in case of any issues. To upgrade to level 2, the mobile number must be registered in the user's own name. National card verification: At this stage, a high-quality photo of the national card must be uploaded, and your national number will be verified. Bank card verification: At this stage, you enter your bank card number. Ensure the bank card holder's name matches the national card image. After this step, you will be able to deposit funds into your Artina account. Bank account verification: At this stage, you enter your account number. Ensure the account holder's name matches the national card image. After this step, you will be able to withdraw funds from your Artina account. Landline and address verification: To upgrade to level 2, providing a landline is mandatory. At this stage, Artina's verification experts will contact you via landline. Photo identification verification: A selfie, taken according to the specified guidelines, is required for level 2 upgrade. For more information about user levels, required documents for upgrade, and limitations of each level, refer to the user account levels page on Artina.
